title: Chill Songs To Build Doohickies To
description: This pack replaces 5 music disks with: "Bad Piggies Theme",  "Building Contraptions", "The Housebuilding Song", "Ride of The Valkyries" and "Hardwhare Store". Made for Create Aeronautics.
body: This resource pack replaces cloud_skipper with the bad piggies theme, replaces blocks with the bad piggies workshop theme "Building Contraptions", replaces cat with Red Dead Redemption 2's "house building song, replaces precipiece with "Rise of the Valkyries", and replaces relic with Weird Al's "Hardware Store." It's easy to tell which ones have been replaced when you search "disc" in the creative menue.
